verdict.rationale: Letta is itself an agent/coding-assistant platform (Letta Code, stateful agents, Agent SDK) — the 'agent as MCP client that connects to MCP servers' role documented in letta-docs-61/76 and letta-comm-3 is the client side, not the product exposing an official MCP server for other agents to connect to. No evidence shows Letta itself running as an MCP server, so this axis is out of category for an agent-type product.
